auditor.name: M/s A D V And Co LLP, Chartered Accountants (Firm's Registration No. 003467N/N500463)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Ongoing GST dispute regarding tax classification and applicable rate on one product (FY 2017-18 to 17.06.2022). Appellate Authority partially allowed appeal: Section 74 invocation set aside, classification under HSN 3921 (18% GST) upheld, demand restricted to FY 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23 (till 17.06.2022) at ₹98.58 Lakhs plus interest and penalty. Company intends to appeal to GSTAT; demand treated as contingent liability, no provision made. ₹18.30 Lakhs deposited as pre-deposit.
